main.description: Side-effect tool example: schedule a long-running report generation that runs as a POD-side LangServer BPMN process (`chat_schedule_report`). Called by the LangGraph agent's schedule_report tool when the user asks for a deferred / scheduled task. Returns immediately with a runId; result is persisted to vertex_chat_artifact when the BPMN completes.

msgId.description: The assistant message that requested this side effect.

deliverAt.description: Optional: specific delivery time. Default = ASAP.
